ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Founders of Schools of jurisprudence.
   B. Say Founders of Schools of jurisprudence has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Founders of Schools of jurisprudence to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan? (1 mark)

   D. Say Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Translation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately
